_meta.description: Known mistakes/lessons for meshes. New entries only get added via ChangeGate's approve() (change_gate.py) -- never edited by hand as a shortcut around review.

patterns.whatToLookFor: Using a static plant/prop NIF (BSTriShape with bhkNPCollisionObject, exported as 'PE Static Art') directly as a creature or armor-addon body. Static meshes have no skin instance, so they cannot follow a skeleton.
patterns.correction: Re-export the geometry as skinned shapes: add every skeleton bone the verts use (names must exactly match the target skeleton, e.g. Root, Hub, Tail1-Tail7 for the radscorpion), set skin-to-bone = inverse of each bone's rest global transform, normalise weights per vertex, set the SLSF1 Skinned shader flag, and drop the static collision object (the race supplies actor collision).
